name: Altar-Gnaw Ooze
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

abilities.name: Reliquary Digestion
abilities.description: When the ooze is in contact with a reliquary or similar consecrated object, the ooze dissolves the object over the course of 1 minute, gaining temporary hit points and leaving behind only a sour, blackened smear.

abilities.name: Adhesive
abilities.description: The ooze adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the ooze is also grappled by it (escape DC 15). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Corrosive Form
abilities.description: A creature that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) acid damage.

condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

generation.userConcept: a cathedral-vault ooze that digests reliquaries
